question: Which of the following options is correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Radon – radioactive rare gas.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Radon is a colourless, odourless, inert gas but **radioactive in nature.**

 
 
• It comes from the natural decay of uranium or thorium found in nearly all soils.
 
• Radon breaks down quickly and gives off radioactive particles.
 
• Long-term exposure to these particles can lead to lung cancer.
 
 
 
• **Hence it is correctly matched.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Argon is a chemical element with the atomic number 18.
 
 
• It is a Nobel gas.
 
• It is in group 18 of the periodic table.
 
• Argon is the third most abundant gas in the Earth's atmosphere (0.094%)
 
• Uses: Fluorescent Lightning, Gas Discharge Tubes, Fluorescent Glow Starters.
 
 
 
• Helium is the second lightest atom.
 
 
• One nucleus of a Helium atom consists of two protons and two neutrons.
 
• Helium atoms do not combine into molecules.
 
• That is why it is called an inert gas, which consists of free atoms.
 
 
 
• Neon belongs to the group of inert gases i.e Group 18.
 
 
• Neon was discovered by William Ramsay.
 
• Neon gives a reddish glow when it is used in neon lamps and tubes.
 
• It is a colorless inert noble gas.
 
• It is also the second lightest noble gas.
